summary: Wishlist is a self-hosted application designed for creating and sharing gift registries with friends and family. It provides a centralised space to manage desired items and coordinate gift-giving among your social circle.
goodFor: This is a suitable choice if you want to self-host a private gift-sharing registry rather than relying on commercial third-party platforms.
watchOut: The project has a moderate maintenance level, meaning you should be prepared to handle potential bugs or lack of rapid feature development yourself.
deployNotes: As it runs via Docker and Kubernetes, you will typically need to configure persistent volume storage for your data and set up a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
